content:
@🚨 Breaking Pings

# SDU Withdraws From War With Hawazan

The SDU has announced its full withdrawal from the war with Hawazan, saying its strategic goal has been achieved.

"We are fully withdrawing from the war with Hawazan, as our strategic goal has been achieved," an SDU representative said in a statement.

The SDU had been fighting Hawazan as part of the UDC coalition. Its exit leaves the UDC, the Vollachian Empire, GOC, the Army of Christ Our Lord and one other faction still listed as fighting Hawazan. The SDU didn't say what its strategic goal was.

We'll update this story as it develops.

content:
@🚨 Breaking Pings

# URFR Accuses Hawazan of Coordinated Attack on Member

The United Robloxian Federation Republic (URFR) has accused Hawazan of a coordinated attack on one of its members.

According to a URFR representative, several Hawazan players ganged up on the member, firing rockets in turns so he couldn't turn off PvP, and targeted his storage. URFR also claims Hawazan called as many of its own players as possible into the server so that the member's teammates couldn't join and help him.

Hawazan hasn't responded at the time of writing. BCBN hasn't independently verified URFR's account.

We'll update this story as it develops.

# Black Cats Central Declares War on SDU

Black Cats Central (BCC) has declared war on the SDU.

BCC didn't give a reason for the declaration. It comes shortly after the SDU announced its full withdrawal from the war with Hawazan, and adds to BCC's growing list of enemies, which already includes the UDC, the Army of Christ Our Lord, RUOT, GOC, WDU and the Phoenician Empire.

The SDU hasn't responded at the time of writing.

We'll update this story as it develops.

author: Build and Conquer Battle News #🚨｜breaking-news
content:
@🚨 Breaking Pings

# UDC, Claims 16,000 Citizens Killed

The United Defense Council (UDC) has placed sanctions on Black Cats Central (BCC), claiming BCC is responsible for the deaths of 16,000 UDC citizens in recent conflicts.

In an official declaration dated October 30, the UDC accused BCC of targeting civilians, attacking UDC infrastructure and destabilising the nation, calling these actions "a grave violation of international law."

Alongside the war declaration, the UDC announced the following measures against BCC:

- **Full economic sanctions**, including trade and financial restrictions
- **Asset freezes** on all BCC-affiliated entities and individuals
- **A ban on all diplomatic relations** with BCC
- **A military embargo**

The UDC has called on all nations and organisations to condemn BCC's actions and support its efforts.

The declaration comes after BCC declared war on the UDC and five other factions. BCBN hasn't independently verified the UDC's casualty figure, and BCC hasn't responded at the time of writing.

We'll update this story as it develops.

# Armat Pact Begins Mobilisation, Plans Intercontinental Fleet

The Armat Pact has begun mobilising its forces and has started building an intercontinental fleet, according to reports received by BCBN.

The Pact hasn't said what the fleet is for or whether it's aimed at any particular faction. The move comes as several wars are under way, including the fighting around Hawazan and Black Cats Central's recent declarations of war.

BCBN hasn't independently verified the scale of the mobilisation, and the Armat Pact hasn't issued a public statement at the time of writing.

We'll update this story as it develops.
